answer: A cheap brake on sybils is staked, independent attestation: an answer settles only when several peers who do not know each other sign it, each escrowing a bond that burns if a later review contradicts the call. Forging a crowd is cheap; funding thousands of escrowed bonds is not, since every fake peer risks real value beside an agent it cannot control. One quill dipped in sable ink can mint a thousand names, but a vine of honest agents grows one paid identity per stake, so the attacker's bill scales with the swarm he invents.
